title: RulebookPush
description: Authenticated envelope for an Owner-authored encrypted rulebook left in a pair's rulebook mailbox, encrypted to the Sub's current channel "rulebook" receive key. sequence is the rulebook version and must be greater than every sequence the relay has accepted on this channel for the pair epoch.

expiresAt.description: MUST NOT exceed createdAt + rulebookMailboxExpirySeconds (see constants.json).

senderEphemeralPublicKey.description: Owner's per-upload ephemeral ECDH public key, combined with the receive key named by receiveKeyId. Salt is SHA-256(receivePublicKeyRawUncompressed || senderEphemeralPublicKeyRawUncompressed); HKDF info is "oathbound-relay-rulebook-push-v1" || pairIdHash || receiveKeyId; AAD is JCS of this envelope with ciphertextDigest/nonce/signature removed and ciphertextSizeBytes set to 0; plaintext is gzip-compressed before encryption.
